34-141-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-3899.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

401-2530-3944-7492.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-7492.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Repeat.

1309-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1309-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
1309-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-4210--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Wayward Disciple trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-1537-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

3284-4550-4871-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
3284-4550-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1358-1636-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Sydri.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1358-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

3617-4823-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-3197-4120-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2921-3197-4120-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4120-4968-7267.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-7267.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-7267.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1020-2034-2866-2906.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost life this turn.
1020-2034-2866-2906.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Repeat.

2034-5320-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-5320-6441.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-5320-6441.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

2150-2281-2292.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1723-2512-2816.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Umbral Mantle ability.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

413-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1003-2173-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

826-3129-4508-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

826-4321-4508-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Food and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

647-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1356-1563-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature and creating a Food token.
Activate the Food token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3484-4364-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aurelia that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the oldest Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aurelia token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Aurelia token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

428-1694-2736-5362.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment.
428-1694-2736-5362.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1274-3490-5231-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2187-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2187-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Possessed Skaab by paying its mana cost.
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Possessed Skaab from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6065.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-3821-6065.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Skyblade's Boon by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Skyblade's Boon spell.
Activate Skyblade's Boon by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-2665-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-2665-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

919-2051-2546-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-2051-2546-4067.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, creature or land.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2108-3511-5220.notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2108-3511-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Guardian Automaton.
When Guardian Automaton dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Guardian Automaton trigger, causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Guardian Automaton on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Guardian Automaton from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Guardian Automaton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

852-2178-2899.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vhati il-Dal.
852-2178-2899.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing any other creature to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Vhati il-Dal triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this process whenever a creature enters the battlefield.

864-1465-4050-4314-4871.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying {2}{W}, returning Eternal Witness to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Sevinne's Reclamation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of Eldrazi Spawns in step 8, giving you infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens.

618-1019-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Your devotion to green is at least seven.
618-1019-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Setessan Petitioner with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
